freshness: Exclude all prior-used notices and known reviewer-exposed sources; log exposure before sample selection.

cohort.interpretation: Descriptive initial cohort, no statistical power claim; requires separate funding and release.
cohort.eligible_frame: Complete archived, official rulemaking notices with public participation text in a prospectively fixed jurisdiction/date interval; freeze interval, jurisdictions, every eligible ID and exclusions before sampling. Reference ambiguity is retained, not an exclusion.
cohort.selection: Sort stable source IDs, then sample without replacement using a published frozen seed; retain complete selection order. Pilot is the first selected eligible case, never an outcome-selected replacement.

direct.input: Full source/reference material and frozen complete operative candidate only; no human scope labels, reasons/evidence annotations, held-out reference or crosswalk.

source_first.A_input: Full source/reference material only; no operational scope or held-out reference.
source_first.B_input: Same full source/reference material, frozen A, operational annotator scope/category/reason/exact evidence/uncertainty per A unit, same candidate. No held-out reference units, adjudication/crosswalk, omissions or direct output.

scope_annotation: A separate operational scope annotator receives only full source/reference material and frozen A inventory. It supplies source-only scope category, reason, exact evidence and uncertainty per A unit to B. It never sees candidate, direct/B outputs, held-out reference units, reviewer adjudication, crosswalks or known omissions. No paid classifier stage.
reference: Two disjoint held-out reference reviewers independently discover obligations/background/unresolved scope from source/reference material only, then adjudicate and freeze reference before model outputs. They do not produce operational B inputs. Reference and adjudication are sealed from operational annotator and both arms until both outputs are frozen. Post-output reviewers crosswalk omissions and audit additions; no feedback or correction reaches either arm.
freeze_before_dispatch: eligible frame, exclusions, selection order and seed
same candidate procedure and candidate hashes
disjoint reviewer/operational annotator identities, exposure logs and sealed information boundaries
exact per-arm annotation inputs and human-effort reporting rules
dispatch_order: Alternate direct-first and source-first-first by sample index; arms isolated without shared outputs/history.
stopping: No retries, repair or favorable replacements; preserve all selected cases and attempted-call reservations. Admit a full three-call pair only after preflight total reservation fits. A failure/overflow prevents B; pair remains failed/incomplete in intended-pair reporting.
metrics: unsupported additions in separate reverse audit
structural failure and full request size
provider reported cost, frozen-rate estimate and conservative debit separately
correct_case_criterion: Independent review confirms all required and identifying obligations, true known losses correctly flagged, no false required-loss findings, no unresolved scope/recovery and completed reverse audit with no incorrect unsupported-addition judgments. Preserve actual record defects separately from verifier correctness.
cost_per_correct_case: Provider-only conservative debit across all selected/attempted cases divided by independently correctly verified cases, labeled provider-only cost per correct case. Zero denominator is undefined. Separately report operational annotation time/compensation by arm and shared reference/evaluation/review time/compensation.

budget.constraint: Recalculate before release if costs/caps change; two leftover calls do not fund a second pair. No paid calls or budget increase here.

interpretation_limits: Synthetic fixtures do not measure model behavior
One pilot does not estimate accuracy
Generated units are not independent samples
No source relabeling or convenient outcome selection
Unequal operational human assistance is an intervention; no automated ordering comparison or gold leakage permitted
comparison_type: human-assisted source-first system versus unassisted direct system; unequal assistance explicitly disclosed; not an automated ordering test

human_boundaries.operational_annotator: Disjoint from both held-out reference reviewers; sees source and frozen A only. Record prior source exposure and all accessible artifacts before annotation. Prior gold/review exposure disqualifies from this operational role for that case.
human_boundaries.held_out_reference_reviewers: Source-only before any A/candidate/direct/B inspection; no role producing arm inputs. Record prior exposure and resolve disagreements in sealed reference. If clean isolation unavailable, stop blind-evaluation claim and retain unverified limitation.
human_boundaries.unblinding: Reference may be unsealed for evaluation only after both arm outputs and operational annotations are frozen. Operational annotator receives no evaluation feedback during any cohort case.
human_boundaries.source_review_envelope: Offline validator host-side attestation/hash binding; not held-out gold or a provider input and not proof of exhaustive discovery.

human_effort_accounting.operational_scope: Record per-case annotator minutes, any compensation and annotation/revision timestamps separately as source-first intervention cost; no unreported gold assistance.
human_effort_accounting.reference_and_evaluation: Record per-case minutes and compensation separately for each held-out reviewer, adjudication, crosswalk, candidate reverse audit and final review; do not attribute shared reference cost to only one arm.
human_effort_accounting.comparison_reporting: Report provider-only dollar/debit metric, operational human assistance time/compensation per arm and shared evaluation/review effort separately. Do not call provider-only dollars total system cost. No implied dollar conversion for unpaid minutes.
